children: According to Sina Finance, U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said that as Nvidia’s interim management investigates what happened, the inquiry will determine whether the company engaged in some form of “dumping.” He also said investigators would examine which products were sold to “shell companies.”
“I think we’ll figure out what happened as the company conducts its investigation,” Bessent said. He added that U.S. President Donald Trump believes H200 chips can be sold.

title: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent: Investigation Will Determine Whether Nvidia Engaged in “Dumping”
